scope: hg38 GitHub marker files actually used by the benchmark (Atlas.U25.l4.hg38.full.tsv, Markers.U250.hg38.tsv)
reason: Paper tables (Nature Suppl. S4A/S4B) are hg19 only. GitHub hg19 files match the paper rows exactly (U25: 953/953; U250: 9288/9288), plus 25/250 Megakaryocyte rows not in the paper. The hg38 files are NOT a liftover of the paper tables: only 67.1% of hg38 U25 blocks and 74.0% of hg38 U250 blocks overlap a same-type paper block lifted to hg38 (atlas values differ from hg19; consistent with markers being recomputed on hg38). Not verifiable as the paper's published tables.

alternative_set.name: paper S4A/S4B single-type markers lifted hg19->hg38 (UCSC chain, pyliftover), expanded to universe CpGs by position
alternative_set.provenance_strength: STRONG for marker identity (published table, 953 U25 / 9288 U250 single-type blocks); lift is ours

unverified: exact find_markers thresholds beyond 'l4' (>=4 CpGs) and 25/250 per type
hg38 marker derivation procedure (not documented in repo)
user_rule: if not sufficiently strong: WSBS profile similarity PRIMARY, marker-kNN SECONDARY (applied by the doc agent)
